title: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 6: Usalama barabarani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child explains an insha ya methali: the whole methali as the title, a story whose events prove it, and a closing that returns to it.
representations: a plan: methali, kisa, kilele, hitimisho
steps: Plan a story that proves it.
Build to the moment it comes true.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child plans a story for the methali.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Methali ni nini?" Kwa nini "kichekesho" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Insha ya methali hufanya nini?" Kwa nini "husimulia hadithi yoyote" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Methali "Haraka haraka haina baraka" inafundisha nini?" Kwa nini "Fanya kila kitu upesi" si jibu sahihi?

misconceptions.repair: Anwani ya insha ya methali ni methali nzima kama ilivyo.

checks.question: Anwani ya insha ya methali ni?
Hitimisho la insha ya methali hufanya nini?

skills.key_step: The child plans insha ya kubuni before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Haraka Haraka Haina Baraka".

listen_for: maelezo ya maana ya methali na mifano mingi
misconceptions.repair: Insha ya methali husimulia kisa kinachothibitisha methali.

misconceptions.ask: Msomaji anajifunza nini katika aya ya mwisho?
misconceptions.repair: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.

listen_for: alichelewa zaidi, ajali ilitokea, alipuuza ishara, dereva aliharakisha
misconceptions.repair: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
Tumia tashbihi, sitiari, methali au nahau kufanya insha iwe hai.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya kubuni kuhusu "Haraka Haraka Haina Baraka"?
checks.answer: Gari lilipaa kama tai juu ya kilima kabla ya kugonga ukingo.

checks.question: Insha ya kubuni ina sehemu zipi?
